title: Gender bias in (non)-contextual clinical word embeddings for stereotypical medical categories

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Direct Bias metric, which measures the average cosine similarity between a computed gender vector and the embeddings of target medical terms. For contextualized embeddings (Clinical-BERT), the paper also uses a fill-in-the-blank masked language modeling task to compare the predicted probability scores of male versus female words in clinical sentence templates.
